wordingCorrection.before: Invariance harness: user checkout tree-hash identical before/after every engine operation across the suite (`invariance.spec`).
wordingCorrection.after: Invariance harness: the harness is exercised and proven non-vacuous in its own dedicated suite, and an invariance assertion is applied around every operation in this package that is handed a user-checkout path — at THREE deliberately different strengths, which the original wording flattened into one uniform claim. (i) FULL user-checkout invariance — `computeWorkingTreeHash` PLUS `computeGitStateHash` over `HEAD`/`config`/`index`/`packed-refs`/every loose ref under `refs/` — at `freezeIntake`, via `withUserCheckoutInvariance` (`intake-freeze.test.ts:186-197`). Correct there, and only there, because a freeze is a pure read that must leave the checkout unchanged in every respect. (ii) WORKING-TREE HASH ONLY, via `withTreeInvariance` (`invariance.ts:144-153`), at three sites: `ensureControlClone`/`fetchRefresh` in 23's git matrix (`e2e/matrix/git/src/scenarios/checkout-invariance-scenario.ts:25-32`), and 08's `applyCasUpdate` (`cas-ref-update.ts:154`) and `preflightMerge` (`merge-preflight.ts:195`) in production. For the two 08 sites this is the strongest assertion available and is documented as such — writing refs (`.git/refs`) and writing objects (`.git/objects`) is precisely what those operations are for, so a `.git`-inclusive hash would flag their intended effect. At the clone-source site it means something weaker and worth stating plainly: the user repo's own `.git` state is NOT asserted unchanged across `ensureControlClone`, only its working tree. (iii) Working tree PLUS a `HEAD`/`index` digest that deliberately EXCLUDES `refs/`, `config` and `packed-refs`, at `publishLocal` — a documented, purpose-built narrowing of 07's harness rather than a reuse of it (`publish-local.ts:19-33` and `:88-99`: 'this operation's entire PURPOSE is to add exactly one new loose ref, so wrapping it in that same combined hash would (correctly) detect its own intended effect as a "mutation" and always fail'). It proves 'HEAD/index/worktree untouched' exactly, not 'nothing in `.git` changed'. The remaining phase-07 operations (`createWorktree`, `destroyWorktree`, `quarantineWorktree`, `sweepOrphanWorktrees`, `analyzeOverlap`) are never given a user-checkout path and operate on control-owned dirs; that they cannot reach one by another route is asserted separately by the ambient-`GIT_DIR` containment test and its positive control (`plumbing.test.ts:177-212`), which dates from `2ff3bce` (2026-08-01), not from this phase's build. Residual, named rather than papered over: no test in this package asserts that a BYSTANDER user checkout is byte-identical across a control-dir operation, so a path-computation bug aiming `createWorktree` or `sweepOrphanWorktrees` at a user checkout would be caught by neither the hash wraps nor the env scrub.

criteria.notes: Three things a reader should not have to reconstruct. (b) `packages/git-engine/src/invariance.test.ts:22-24`'s own doc comment STILL asserts the overstated claim ('every other test file in this package wraps its operation in `withTreeInvariance`'), as does the built `dist/invariance.d.ts:5-6`; the source-of-truth correction lives in the evidence README and now here. Left as-is rather than edited, per the pass rule against fixing findings in the same pass — it is a stale comment, not a failing check. (c) Re-resolved 2026-08-02 after rebasing onto `af46e00` (#52/#53/#56): none of those PRs touched a file this record cites, and all 51 code-shaped quoted assertions were re-located against the rebased tree. The cited CI run is green at `65ff0da`, the branch point; the closeout PR's own CI run covers the rebased tree. (d) The correction is more precise, not weaker: the guarantee the box carries — no operation in this package mutates the user's checkout — is evidenced by hash for every operation that can reach one, and by env containment for the rest. Recorded honestly: for the second group that containment is one commit old.

wordingCorrection.before: Every entry this package journals matches the `git_freeze` or `worktree_quarantine` member of `JournalEntryType` and passes 02's discriminated-union exhaustiveness harness (mirrors 13's own exit-criterion phrasing for the same harness).
wordingCorrection.after: Every entry THIS PHASE's operations journal matches the `git_freeze` or `worktree_quarantine` member of `JournalEntryType` and passes 02's discriminated-union exhaustiveness harness. "This package" was accurate when written — 07 built `packages/git-engine` alone — but phase 08 has since extended the same package in place (this phase's own §Out of scope: "08 and 07 are two phases building one package") and journals `cas_ref_update` and `evidence_pointer` from `src/integration-journal.ts`. Those two are themselves closed members of the same 13-member union and are proven disjoint from this phase's two, so the package-wide property the criterion was reaching for — this package never journals an undeclared type — still holds and is still tested.

criteria.notes: Why this is a correction and not a weakening. The phase file's own §Interfaces produced already scopes the guarantee to the phase ("this phase is the sole writer of the `git_freeze` and `worktree_quarantine` members of `JournalEntryType`'s 13-member union"), and 08 carries its own exit criterion for its own two members.
